arguments.command:
set -eu
BASE=/home/storage/781/4477781/user/webapp
ENVFILE="$BASE/ollama-runtime.env"
KEEP="$BASE/bin/ollama-keepalive"
LOCK="$BASE/.ollama-keepalive/ensure-v2.lock"
WARM_PATH="$BASE/runtime-domains/automation/warm-residency.sh"
EXPECTED_SHA=8ae119694047cd33c53bfba16e36badc76a67c64e12695d1bfd5c08494977f59

actual="$(sha256sum "$ENVFILE" | awk '{print $1}')"
[ "$actual" = "$EXPECTED_SHA" ] || { echo "CAS_ABORT env_sha=$actual"; exit 20; }
[ "$(grep -c '^export OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE=30m$' "$ENVFILE" || true)" = "1" ] || { echo "CAS_ABORT keepalive_not_30m"; exit 21; }
[ "$(crontab -l 2>/dev/null | grep -F -c "$WARM_PATH" || true)" = "0" ] || { echo "CAS_ABORT warm_cron_present"; exit 22; }

ts="$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)"
BDIR="$BASE/backups/ollama-finite-baseline-$ts"
mkdir -p "$BDIR"; chmod 700 "$BDIR"
cp -p "$ENVFILE" "$BDIR/ollama-runtime.env.before"

tmp="$(mktemp "$BASE/.ollama-runtime.env.XXXXXX")"
sed 's/^export OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE=30m$/export OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE=10m/' "$ENVFILE" >"$tmp"
chmod 600 "$tmp"
mv "$tmp" "$ENVFILE"

echo "ROLLBACK_DIR=$BDIR"
echo '--- CONFIG_AFTER ---'
grep -n -E '^export OLLAMA_(KEEP_ALIVE|CONTEXT_LENGTH|MAX_LOADED_MODELS|NUM_PARALLEL)=' "$ENVFILE"

exec 8>"$LOCK"
flock -x 8
pid="$(pgrep -f "^$BASE/miniconda/bin/ollama serve$" | head -n1 || true)"
if [ -n "$pid" ]; then
  echo "OLD_PID=$pid"
  kill -TERM "$pid"
  i=0
  while kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null && [ "$i" -lt 30 ]; do sleep 1; i=$((i+1)); done
  kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null && { echo "STOP_TIMEOUT=$pid"; exit 23; } || true
fi
rm -f "$BASE/ollama-runtime.pid"
flock -u 8

i=0
while [ "$i" -lt 3 ]; do
  "$KEEP" ensure && break
  rc=$?
  [ "$rc" = "75" ] || exit "$rc"
  sleep 2
  i=$((i+1))
done

i=0
while [ "$i" -lt 20 ]; do
  curl -fsS --max-time 3 http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/version >/dev/null 2>&1 && break
  sleep 1
  i=$((i+1))
done
curl -fsS --max-time 5 http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/version >/dev/null
newpid="$(pgrep -f "^$BASE/miniconda/bin/ollama serve$" | head -n1 || true)"
[ -n "$newpid" ] || { echo NO_NEW_PID; exit 24; }
echo "NEW_PID=$newpid"
echo '--- EFFECTIVE_ENV ---'
tr '\0' '\n' <"/proc/$newpid/environ" | grep -E '^OLLAMA_(KEEP_ALIVE|CONTEXT_LENGTH|MAX_LOADED_MODELS|NUM_PARALLEL|NUM_THREAD)=' | sort
echo '--- API_PS ---'
curl -fsS --max-time 5 http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/ps; echo
echo '--- WARM_CRON_COUNT ---'
(crontab -l 2>/dev/null | grep -F -c "$WARM_PATH" || true)
echo '--- KEEPALIVE_STATUS ---'
"$KEEP" status
